body_html: 1、SECURE ENCLOSED DESIGN: The dog crate features a closed structure that effectively protects mother cats and kittens, preventing external disturbances and providing a comfortable, quiet environment during nursing. 2、SPACIOUS INTERIOR: The octagonal design offers ample space for the mother cat to move freely while providing enough room for kittens to grow, catering to the diverse needs of your feline family. 3、EXCELLENT VENTILATION: Constructed from high toughness mesh materials, this travel crate ensures optimal airflow, keeping the interior freshness and preventing overheating, essential for the health of both mother and kittens. 4、EASY TO CLEAN: With a smooth interior that resists dirt buildup and a detachable design, this dog kennel allows for simple daily cleaning and maintenance, ensuring a clean living environment for your precious kittens. 5、PORTABLE AND CONVENIENT: Lightweight and easy to carry, this crate tent is designed for both indoor and outdoor use, allowing for effortless mobility and setup, so your cats can feel safe and comfortable in different environments.Item Type: Portable Dog CrateMaterial: Fabric1 x Portable Dog Crate
